title: application_insights Model
description: AI-scaffolded schema for JSON-driven application_insights definitions — verify field constraints before use.

application_insights.description: Map keyed by a stable logical id. The key becomes the for_each key in Terraform.

resource_group_name.description: Must match the "name" of an entry in resource-group.json.

application_type.description: The type of application being monitored (for example, 'web', 'ios', 'java', 'Node.JS', 'other'). This determines how Application Insights collects and displays telemetry data.

daily_data_cap_in_gb.description: The maximum amount of data in gigabytes that can be ingested per day. When this limit is reached, data collection stops until the next day.

daily_data_cap_notifications_disabled.description: Whether to disable email notifications when the daily data cap is reached. Set to true to turn off notifications, false to receive them.

disable_ip_masking.description: Whether to disable IP address masking in telemetry data. Set to true to store full IP addresses, false to mask the last octet for privacy.

force_customer_storage_for_profiler.description: Whether to require customer-managed storage for the Application Insights Profiler feature. Set to true to use your own storage account.

internet_ingestion_enabled.description: Whether data can be ingested into Application Insights from the public internet. Set to false to restrict ingestion to private networks only.

internet_query_enabled.description: Whether Application Insights data can be queried from the public internet. Set to false to restrict queries to private networks only.

local_authentication_disabled.description: Whether to disable local authentication methods (like API keys). Set to true to require Azure Active Directory authentication only.

retention_in_days.description: The number of days to retain telemetry data before it is automatically deleted. Common values are 30, 60, 90, 120, 180, 270, 365, 550, or 730 days.

sampling_percentage.description: The percentage of telemetry data to collect (0-100). For example, 50 means only half of the telemetry will be stored, reducing costs while maintaining statistical validity.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the Log Analytics workspace to which Application Insights data should be sent. If not specified, a classic Application Insights resource is created instead.
